lines.text: Potiphar, captain of the guard, buys Joseph from the Ishmaelites and puts him in charge of everything he owns.
Potiphar's wife asks Joseph to sleep with her, but he refuses her day after day.
When no servants are inside, she grabs Joseph's cloak, and he leaves it and runs to the fields.
Potiphar burns with anger at his wife's story and sells Joseph to another master.

wrong_details.true: has Joseph thrown into the king's prison

lines.text: In prison the LORD is with Joseph, and the warden puts all the prisoners in his care.
